PARANOIA.missionObjectives: When you are given your assignment you can keep track of the objective here, that way you don't forget anything important, Citizen!
PARANOIA.assignedGear: List any of the gear you're responsible for here. Be sure to keep it in tip-top shape!
PARANOIA.aliases: List your alternative identities. Perfect for when you need to blend in... or stand out!
PARANOIA.secretObjective: Record your covert mission. Stay discreet; we wouldn't want any surprises, would we?
PARANOIA.serviceGroupFavors: Track favors owed to you by your service group and those you've called in. Cooperation keeps Alpha Complex running smoothly!
PARANOIA.secretSociety: Document your treasonous society. Remember, revealing this could lead to unauthorized fun!
PARANOIA.mutantPower: Note your forbidden abilities. Remember, unauthorized mutations are not a laughing matter... unless they're hilarious!
PARANOIA.secretSocietyFavors: Note favors from your society and any favors asked of you by Fellow members. Loyalty earns perks... and sometimes, extra lives!
PARANOIA.treasonousGear: Catalog illegal items here. Not that you would have anything like that, of course.
PARANOIA.evidence: Log evidence against traitors. Blackmail can be such a delightful team-building exercise!
PARANOIA.notes: Keep track of any other interesting, potentially-treasonous details. A well-documented traitor is a well-prepared traitor!
